description: Address review issues: Fix stale cache on notification clear/dismiss/block, batch N+1 queries in populate, add TTL to Redis keys, add populate race condition lock.
steps: 1. Fix Issue #1 (stale cache): Add PendingMentionCache.remove calls in v1 NotificationsController#dismiss, add PendingMentionCache.clear_for_account in v1/v2 NotificationsController#clear, add cleanup in AfterBlockService and AfterBlockDomainFromAccountService.
2. Fix Issue #2 (N+1 queries): Batch the Favourite.exists? and Status.exists? calls in PendingMentionCache.populate into two bulk WHERE IN queries.
3. Fix Issue #3 (No TTL): Add a TTL (14 days) on the Redis key, refreshed on writes (add method).
4. Fix Issue #4 (Race condition): Add a simple Redis SETNX lock around populate to prevent concurrent population.
5. Add a clear_for_account class method to PendingMentionCache that deletes the entire key for an account.
acceptance_criteria: When notifications are cleared via v1 or v2 clear action, the pending mentions cache for that account is also cleared
When a notification is dismissed via v1 dismiss action, it is removed from pending mentions cache if present
When a user blocks someone, pending mention notifications from that account are cleaned from the cache
The populate method uses batch queries (2 SQL queries total instead of N per notification)
The Redis key has a 14-day TTL that is refreshed on writes
Concurrent populate calls are guarded by a Redis lock
verification: Run ruby -c on all modified Ruby files to verify syntax
